It is DATA selecting a target, never proof the target is owned by the closer.
COMMAND.note: COMMAND document SHA remains request command_sha256; distinct from exact UTF8 shell SHA. Sources/counts/pins are typed selected DATA, not loaded-module/native/profile authority.

FINANCIAL_ADJUDICATION.result_groups: Bounded typed group IDs/original raw pins/predeclared golden pins/declared inventory pins/expected observed counts/semantic PASS FAIL UNREVIEWED; chosen layout validated by independent original detail review, never by an arbitrary callback. FINANCIAL_ADJUDICATION.scope_flags: All execution/native/currentness/profile/fullcaller/gain/all_costs_settled flags exactlyFalse. Financial closure alone does not qualify payload semantics.

METER_START.note: No precomputed timestamp, late sample, native PID capability or retroactive formal START. Source-coded body_scope exact tag, not arbitrary declaration.

NATIVE_CHAIN.calls: Ordered ordinal/tool/request_pin/original_tool_result_pin records. Directterminal or sessionchain; no nested/wrapped/normalized Tool object.
NATIVE_CHAIN.correlation: First actual request exactmatches original COMMAND selected request. Later original write_stdin requests use same session_id returned by firstrunning Tool; every running reply session matches. Terminal may omit session_id: original matching request supplies same-session correlation, not a fabricated terminal field.
NATIVE_CHAIN.phase: original parent API call requests and delivered Tool result files, immutable rawbytes
NATIVE_CHAIN.tool_shapes: Per documented exec/write_stdin API: required output/wall_time_seconds, optional chunk_id/original_token_count, RUNNING session_id exactint with absent/null exit_code, TERMINAL exactsignedint exit_code with session_id absent or same current session. Unknown keys/shape/outcome retained unresolved, not ignored.
NATIVE_CHAIN.unknown: Missing terminal, mismatched session, discarded request, chaingap or >64steps blocks admission. A bounded source/profile call plan must fit the cap; no indefinite polling grant.
NATIVE_CHAIN.wall_scope: DIAGNOSTIC-POLICY.json exact F3 lexical policy, original raw Tool unchanged; decimal diagnostic tokens are lexical strings, walls never enter charges.

OPENING.note: Exactly one fixed old F3 base, no nesting or per-command base copies. Per-entry manifests keep global opening below131072 bytes; rawnative request/result files reside once in bounded suffix.

PERMISSION.note: Prospectively original real manual grant, never minted by financial parser. Does NOT contain COMMAND document SHA, avoiding cycles when shell includes grant SHA.
PERMISSION.phase: original parent permission before COMMAND, outside financial-parser authority

PRE_ENTRY.note: execution_startedFalse is historical pre-entry fact, never owner proof. Any reserved/orphan operation absent a terminal reviewed close blocks.

After verified CLOSE/head commit target reservation replaced by QT once; closer RC remains until later original measured manual cost/adjudication.

STATE.note: All reservations/entry directories in actual source-authenticated namespace census exactly represented, includingorphans/pending/unknown. Closedprice and source/event prefixes immutable. Three legacy ops priced only through one verified base. No future state-schema per attempt.
STATE.phase: original generic current parent ledger from first prospective operation onward

metadata_close_scope: METADATA_CLOSE is a distinct source-private completion transition, never ordinary NEW or payload ACTIVE. LIFECYCLE.json defines the only two-visible-entry rule, all unknown/other pending rejection and zero payload authority.
